$comment: Z-Image-Turbo batch for the realms' own rooms (2026-10-09; src/renderer/components/realmRoomArt.ts). One painted room per realm, each the place the realm is named for, at the dungeon ring's plate size and camera (wide, low, the floor open at the centre where the board sits) so the board and the HUD land on it the way they land on the ring. Render: py -3.12 scripts/card-pipeline/batch_local_zimage.py --manifest scripts/card-pipeline/realm-rooms.zimage.manifest.json --cpu-offload ; pick from tmp/zimage/realm-rooms.zimage.manifest/contact-sheet.png and copy the take to `target`. Then cut it into the two layers the room is lit with: py -3.12 scripts/scene-pipeline/segment_realm.py <take> <realm> <out> writes bg-gameplay-realm-<realm>-v1-base.png (the room with its light taken down) and -glow.png (the realm-hue light and the near-white highlights, additive) plus a check sheet; copy base and glow into src/renderer/assets/ui/backgrounds/ and run yarn assets:ui-backgrounds:export-runtime-webp. (scene.sh is the dungeon ring's own: its segmenter, flame boxes and Blender room are measured on that plate.) The game picks a realm's room up as soon as its base is there and preloads it. The installed takes (2026-10-09) are in realm-rooms.zimage.picks.json, candidate n at the entry's seed + n - 1; the grove's prompt lost its 'antique gold trim', which painted a gold picture frame round all three first takes. Prompts describe only what is there (Turbo has no negative prompt, and the art rules ask for positive-only prompts).
